The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 dbb30c29398fcfa0), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. statement: Let X be a compact irreducible holomorphic symplectic Kähler manifold of complex dimension 2n, where n ≥ 1. If a holomorphic line bundle L satisfies c1(L) ̸= 0, c1(L) ∈ KX, qX(c1(L)) = 0, then L is semiample. More precisely, there exist a positive integer m, a normal projective variety B, an ample line bundle A on B, and a surjective holomorphic map with connected fibers f : X −→ B, Lm ≃ f∗ A, such that dimC B = n. Every irreducible component of every fiber has complex dimension n, and σ vanishes on its smooth locus.
